Every number here was measured on our four boxes and recorded in the run ledger (`runs/runs.jsonl`, sealed segments `runs/runs.NNNN.jsonl.gz` first). This file is generated from that ledger by our publishing step; nothing in it is a prediction except the columns that say so. Decode and prefill are tokens per second.
